Appoint.title: Appoint a medrese nazır
Changes.note: “Appoint” makes the person you found a nazır of this medrese: they start with no permission, and the appointment is written to the audit log with the level you appoint at. Everyone who can open this page sees the nazırs. “Dismiss” takes the nazır’s post and permissions in this medrese and its courses away at once; what they gave others follows your choice: with Take over it stays and you appear as its giver, with Drop it is withdrawn at once. The dismissal is written to the audit log and cannot be undone; the person can be appointed again, but their permissions must be given again.
Dismiss.answersNote: If you take over, the role and permissions stay and you appear as the giver; if you drop, they are taken back at once. Every decision is written to the audit log.
Dismiss.cascade: Someone whose post you are dropping gave roles or permissions to others, which would stay without anyone deciding on them. Dismiss that person first and decide on what they gave, or take their post over.
